QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when assembly is enabled. Otherwise it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... This stops the compiler from proving a value
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the primitive and its role, but it only places the module in `library/constant_time_impl.h` generally. It never says that `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` is defined in that file.
